notes: An arm is a set of runtime config keys (lib/aiModels.js). Since R0 the agent loop (baybay_agent) and guarded professional answers (baybay_professional) have their own default, Claude Sonnet 5.5 at effort low, and the legacy all-route ANTHROPIC_BAYBAY_MODEL/EFFORT no longer move them; arms name BAYBAY_MODEL_AGENT / BAYBAY_MODEL_PROFESSIONAL. A route whose model a variable changes to another model takes its effort from BAYBAY_EFFORT_<ROUTE>, else from ANTHROPIC_BAYBAY_EFFORT (anything except 'low' is 'medium'); a variable that pins the default model keeps effort low.
code-defaults sets nothing: it measures exactly what this checkout ships.
Professional topics never run on Haiku 5.5 (RC-20), so the Haiku arms answer them on the professional route's default (Sonnet 5.5 low).

The nothink arm uses BAYBAY_THINKING_AGENT=disabled, which lib/aiModels.js sends to Haiku 5.5 only (it is a 400 on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5). Harness-level requestOverrides are still accepted for a thinking override, but only on an arm whose agent and professional routes both resolve to Haiku.
opus-asis is production before R0: every route on Opus 5.5 at effort medium.

API-BB-ENGINE: v2-* arms set BAYBAY_ENGINE=v2 (router, single-call fast path, v2 retrieval, frozen cached system block). The fast route defaults to Sonnet 5.5 low; v2-haiku-low moves only the fast route to Haiku 5.5 low (plans and professional topics stay on Sonnet low). code-defaults was engine v1 when the engine set ran (now the v1-code-defaults arm).

API-BB-STREAM: set stream = block A on v2-code-defaults; the harness is a capable client (streamVersion 3) unless --no-drafts, so v2 fast-path turns stream their lead as draft events and the report shows lead TTFT for drafted turns.

API-BB-CUTOVER: the engine default is now v2, so code-defaults (no config) runs v2, the same as v2-code-defaults. v1-code-defaults pins BAYBAY_ENGINE=v1 (the rollback, production before the cut-over). The pre-ENGINE model arms (opus-asis, haiku-*, sonnet-*) pin BAYBAY_ENGINE=v1 so they keep measuring the v1 research loop they were built for. The engine set compares against v1-code-defaults.
API-BB-5: v2-plan-agent runs a new site day plan on the agent rounds again (BAYBAY_DAY_PLAN_FAST=off), to compare plan quality with the one-call default on the same turns.

API-BB-5: set bb5 = block M (36 turns in 25 conversations: 25 turns / 17 conversations written for the lane, 6 review-round-1 turns, 5 held-out single turns written after the round-1 code freeze; see the casebook notes: multi-turn constraint carry, dated spans, English asks, area and rail fit, guide facts) on v2-code-defaults, pinned Wed 2026-10-14 12:00 PT: run it with --now 2026-10-14T12:00:00-07:00. gold.evidenceIncludes / evidenceMustNotInclude check the turn's retrieved records and gold.planRail the plan's stops without a model.

API-BB-6: set bb6 = block N (GPT's 40 unseen questions, 46 turns: 20 dev + 20 held-out cases split before any code change; family and Chinese-community event facts, DMV, Medi-Cal, Medicare, Social Security, tax help, renting, senior transit, scams, four 911 emergencies, six two-turn changes of age, budget, language, back-by time, residence and application channel) on v2-code-defaults, pinned Fri 2026-10-16 10:00 PT: run it with --now 2026-10-16T10:00:00-07:00.

API-BB-7: set bb7 = block O (fresh dev + held-out pairs for block N's seven held-out failure types, written before any code change: age said as 'X, almost Y', a dated city ask with an age, a neighbourhood that names its city, Social Security credits, a withheld deposit, a changed budget of zero, a follow-up without its topic noun; plus three rainy-day family asks) on v2-code-defaults, pinned Fri 2026-10-16 10:00 PT: run it with --now 2026-10-16T10:00:00-07:00. Tune only on dev.

API-BB-QUALITY: set quality = blocks I (multi-turn convergence: the BB-LIVE 10-11 conversations W1, W2, M1, W3, L2 plus new follow-ups; gold.state checks the carried task state, gold.needsPlan the plan card) and J (professional-topic routing, false negatives, thin evidence, English cards) on code-defaults. Both books are pinned at Mon 2026-10-12 09:00 PT: run them with --now 2026-10-12T09:00:00-07:00, separately from the 10-08 books.

code-defaults.label: Code defaults (engine v2 since API-BB-CUTOVER; fast path, agent and professional on Sonnet 5.5, effort low)

v1-code-defaults.label: Engine v1 on code defaults (BAYBAY_ENGINE=v1, the rollback; production before API-BB-CUTOVER)

v2-code-defaults.label: Engine v2 on code defaults (fast path and agent on Sonnet 5.5 low)

v2-plan-agent.label: Engine v2 with a new site day plan on the agent rounds again (BAYBAY_DAY_PLAN_FAST=off; API-BB-5 made it one call)

v2-haiku-low.label: Engine v2, fast path on Haiku 5.5 low (agent and professional on Sonnet 5.5 low)

v2-haiku-low-nothink.label: Engine v2, fast path on Haiku 5.5 low with thinking disabled

sonnet-medium.label: Sonnet 5.5 (R0 default model), effort medium: adaptive thinking more likely, for the tool-round probe
